parts.official_mark_scheme_text: Correctly separate variables and integrate at least one side. M1; to obtain $a\ln y$ or $b\ln(x+1)+c\ln(3x+1)$. Obtain the term $\ln y$ from $\int 1/y$. B1. State or imply $\dfrac{A}{x+1}+\dfrac{B}{3x+1}$ and use a correct method to find a constant. M1. Obtain $A=-\dfrac12$ and $B=\dfrac32$. A1. Obtain $-\dfrac12\ln(x+1)+\dfrac12\ln(3x+1)$, or an equivalent combination. A1+A1 FT on $A,B$. Use $x=1,y=1$ to evaluate the integration constant, or use limits, in a solution containing all three non-zero log terms. M1. Obtain an expression for $y$ or $y^2$ and substitute $x=3$. DM1; do not accept decimal equivalents of log terms. Obtain $y=\dfrac12\sqrt5$, $\sqrt{\dfrac54}$ or $\sqrt{\dfrac{10}{8}}$. A1 ISW; the result must be simplified and exact, and $1.118$ is not allowed; the printed guidance also accepts $e^{\frac12\ln(5/4)}$. Total 9.
